notes: Pricing data is official-source evidence and is intentionally stored separately from OSM/route-traversal evidence.
Ивановское (Р241) is the current official matrix label for the stop also shown as Иннополис on the public adjacent-section tariff page.
sections[].rvpKm reproduces the RVP kilometre marker published for the corresponding adjacent section on Avtodor's current tariff page; it is not inferred from route geometry.

The 2026-03-02 order and legacy Moscow–Shali assertion predate the 2026-10-08 paid-section extension. Do not use that assertion for trips crossing the new Сокуры–Шали section. The current direct Сокуры-exit→Шали vector is recorded separately below; do not append it to adjacent rates or generalize it to other endpoints.

The direct Sokury-exit→Shali all-day price of 99 RUB from 2026-10-08 is published. Do not infer a new Moscow→Shali fare by adding 99 to the old Moscow→Shali amount: the old assertion may overlap the prior toll boundary and the new OD vector must be directly obtained from the operator matrix/calculator.

2026-10-12 review: the official holding-company announcement confirms the 99-RUB Cat-I direct span from the Sokury exit to Shali (the M-7 junction) and states that Shali–Bavly stays free when the route does not enter the M-12 mainline or cross the toll boundary. The direct span is not mapped to the legacy kazan_p239 stop: no published source proves those endpoints are identical. The live Avtodor tariff page linked from the announcement returned HTTP 403 to the research fetcher; do not fabricate refreshed Moscow/Kazan-to-Shali pair fares.
